gaps.sentence: For the ___ of clarity, I will repeat the rules.

gaps.sentence: We're ___ the impression that the offer had expired.

gaps.sentence: ___ good fortune, nobody was hurt in the collapse.

gaps.sentence: ___ terms of quality, the cheaper model wins.
___ second thoughts, maybe we should postpone.
The team is out of ___ after the long break.

gaps.sentence: Given the budget, a new stadium is ___ of the question.

gaps.sentence: ___ any rate, we still have enough time.
